fields.description: Name shown in lists. Defaults to the hostname.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Set on first save, e.g. n1.blr.frappemail.com. Reverse DNS of the IP must point to it.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Where the server runs, e.g. DigitalOcean BLR1. For information only.
fields.label: Location

fields.description: full: serves clients and sends mail. frontend: serves clients only. outbound: sends mail only. Single-node clusters use full.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Clear to take the node out of service and stop Stalwart.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Pending: not provisioned. Provisioning: a job runs. Provisioned: waits for Stalwart to be healthy. Active: serving. Draining: out of DNS for maintenance. Failed: see Last Error. Disabled: stopped by an operator.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Provisioned
Active
Draining
Failed
Disabled

fields.description: Ran the first setup. Cannot be deleted while the cluster is active.
fields.label: Is Bootstrap Node

fields.description: Stalwart release installed by the last job.
fields.label: Installed Version

fields.description: Why the last job or check failed.
fields.label: Last Error

fields.description: Public IPv4 of the server, used for SSH and DNS.
fields.label: IPv4 Address

fields.description: Optional. Gets an AAAA record.
fields.label: IPv6 Address

fields.description: The cluster hostname resolves to this node.
fields.label: In Ingress DNS

fields.description: Reverse DNS of the IPv4 points to the hostname. Set it at the server provider.
fields.label: PTR Verified

fields.description: Blank uses the cluster SSH user.
fields.label: SSH User

fields.description: Blank uses the cluster SSH port.
fields.label: SSH Port

fields.description: Verify SSH reached the server. Required before Provision.
fields.label: SSH Verified

fields.description: Recorded on first SSH contact and checked on each connection. After a reinstall, run Reset SSH Host Keys.
fields.label: SSH Host Keys

fields.description: ID in the Stalwart cluster registry. 0 on a single node without a coordinator.
fields.label: Node ID

fields.description: When the last provisioning or upgrade job succeeded.
fields.label: Provisioned At

fields.description: When Stalwart last passed a health check.
fields.label: Last Health At
